jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — AI-Accelerated Delivery
jobs.description:
Work as an Orchestrator in a small, senior-weighted AI-accelerated pod — directing AI tooling, validating output rigorously, and peer-reviewing a fellow senior engineer. This is not a conventional developer role.

This is not a conventional senior developer role. We're hiring Senior Software Engineers into our new AI-accelerated delivery pods — a small, senior-weighted team that delivers complex software engagements differently to how the industry has done it for the past decade.

Inside the pod, this role is called an Orchestrator. We're not hiring engineers to write code in the traditional sense — we're hiring senior engineers to use AI tooling to amplify their own judgement and experience, build substantive output through that direction, and peer-review the work of another senior engineer alongside structured tooling support. The skill is specification, judgement, and validation.

You'll work as one of two Orchestrators in a pod of four, supported by a Client Lead. Pod work is judged on outcomes, not just hours, and compensation sits on a different track: a higher base salary than equivalent senior roles, plus quarterly outcome-based variable compensation tied to pod-level delivery and client satisfaction. This is a hybrid role in our Cape Town office — Tuesday to Friday in office, Mondays remote.

If you want clear instructions, short feedback loops, story points to count, and a project manager telling you what to do every day, this role will be uncomfortable. If you've been using AI tools seriously and have developed an instinct for when they're right and when they're subtly wrong, it's built for you.

All AI use in Bitcube delivery operates within our AI Acceptable Use Policy and AI Development Standard, governed by our ISO 42001 management system.

Responsibilities

  • Direct AI tooling (Claude Code, Gemini, CodeRabbit, and our internal CLI) to produce substantive software output, then review and validate it rigorously before it ships
  • Peer-review the other Orchestrator's work with structured tooling support — every meaningful piece of output is reviewed by a second senior engineer before it reaches the client
  • Translate written specifications into executable architecture and design decisions
  • Engage directly with clients during demo cycles and milestone reviews
  • Contribute to the orchestration playbook — the documented patterns, prompt templates, and review checklists that compound across engagements

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of professional software engineering experience in production environments
  • Strong proficiency across at least two of: modern JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js, React, Angular, or Vue), Python, C#, or comparable production languages
  • Deep understanding of software architecture, system design, and the trade-offs involved in production engineering at scale
  • Genuine, current, hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Aider, or similar) in real production work
  • The ability to read AI-generated code critically
  • Strong written communication and the maturity to operate without daily supervision

Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern deployment practices — containerisation, infrastructure as code, CI/CD
  • Familiarity with backend API development, frontend architecture, mobile, data engineering, or AI/ML integration
  • Experience in agency, consultancy, or product-team environments with direct client engagement
  • Familiarity with ISO 27001 or ISO 42001 frameworks

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Generous leave policy
  • Private medical aid
  • Company pension contribution
  • Continuous learning allowance
  • Life coach access
  • Fitness allowance
  • Group life and disability insurance
  • All-day breakfast, bean-to-cup coffee, Friday drinks
  • Gaming areas in every office

jobs.description: Build practical applications, integrations and AI-enabled automation across Python, APIs, data and cloud — using Claude to accelerate delivery and turn manual processes into reliable solutions. We're looking for hands-on Automation Developers to build practical applications, integrations and AI-enabled automation solutions for our clients. Candidates looking to relocate to Cape Town are welcome to apply (relocation costs would need to be covered personally).
